title: Democratic Legitimacy of Community-Based Initiatives
descriptions: The dataset of the doctoral research of Kors Visscher. It contains the datapackage with transcripts of his interviews with active citizens. It contains 40 transcripts, a datamanagement plan, a description of the datapackage, a researchplan, the written information respondents received (in Dutch) and the informed consent form (in Dutch).
